items.title: Fear and 'Hot Sauce': Young Investors Want To Catch Up
items.summary: Buzzy stocks, leveraged ETFs, and a generation feeling left behind. BlackRock's Gargi Chaudhuri discusses ways investors can dabble in risky products while also leaning into time-proven strategies. On this week's "Bloomberg Money", she joins Tom Keene and Scarlet Fu, who gives a shoutout to @Eric Balchunas and his coverage of 'hot sauce' investment products.

items.title: Bitcoin Breaks Below $60,000. BlackRock's ETF Suffers Record $541 Million Withdrawal.
items.summary: BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF recorded its largest daily withdrawal as Bitcoin fell below $60,000. Bitfinex's Jag Kooner explains what could signal a recovery.

items.title: Why Is Wells Fargo (WFC) Losing A $1.3 Billion Team While Bitcoin ETF Holdings Grow?
items.summary: Wells Fargo (NYSE:WFC) has lost a multigenerational financial advisor group overseeing about US$1.3b in client assets to &Partners. The departing wealth management team had been based at Wells Fargo and served clients across multiple generations within families. Separately, Wells Fargo has doubled client holdings in BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF while the wider bitcoin ETF market has seen outflows. The combination of a US$1.3b advisor exit and higher client exposure to BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF...

items.summary: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost $582.3 million on Thursday, and about $543 million of leveraged bets were wiped out in 24 hours as AI stocks sold off.
